components.name: Primary writing link
components.description: The homepage primary CTA is a plain underlined link without a filled rectangle.

components.name: Theme toggle
components.description: Accessible light/dark switch in the masthead.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Switch to light theme" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"/><path d="M12 4.5a7.5 7.5 0 0 1 0 15Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>

narrative.overview: Published technical work demonstrates understanding through explanation, reproducible examples, and honest tradeoffs. The interface stays quiet: a text-only masthead, a short production-AI statement with one primary CTA, a featured story, up to four recent posts, topic links, and a small utility footer. Keep the personal introduction concise.
keyCharacteristics: A concise statement and one clear action that lead directly to useful writing.
Aligned editorial columns and hairline rules.
Charcoal canvas, warm text, and a restrained sage accent.
Static reading content with small, accessible interactive controls.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Use only #141819, #F1F0EA, #3B4343, and #B6C7BB in both themes. Reuse the semantic variables without blends or additional shades.

rules.name: The Reading Pair Rule
rules.body: Use Public Sans for navigation, titles, metadata, summaries, and article headings; reserve Georgia for long-form prose.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep publication surfaces flat; distinguish them through rules, spacing, and semantic tonal fields.

dos: **Do** preserve the charcoal/sage palette roles in both themes and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** use aligned columns, generous whitespace, and hairline rules to organize content.
**Do** retain the Public Sans / Georgia split between interface and article prose.
**Do** build explanatory art as original SVG diagrams and keep sample-content labels clear.
**Do** collapse editorial columns and contain wide code and tables on small screens.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, rounded card shells, or decorative gradients to publication surfaces.
**Don't** give the homepage primary CTA a filled rectangle or introduce colors outside the approved four.
**Don't** replace explanatory vector diagrams with generic decorative stock imagery.
**Don't** rely on motion or color alone to communicate control state.
